note: Wave 6 — mission_applied. Four federal sites (transportation.gov, ahrq.gov, neh.gov, seagrant.noaa.gov) refuse plain text fetches with HTTP 403; three were resolved with a rendering browser or the search index and one was not. Several rows here rest on pages last dated 2024-2025 rather than on a live deadline, and each says so.

updates.status_evidence: “The deadline for this cycle has passed. Updated guidelines will be posted in advance of the next deadline”; the next cycle opens 15 January 2027 with a 14 April 2027 deadline. Between cycles, not wound down.

NEH's Summer Stipends page remains published and states the programme provides $8,000 for two consecutive months of full-time work, with “Updated guidelines will be posted in advance of the next deadline”.
updates.notes_append: Award confirmed 2026-09-17 at $8,000 flat, so the earlier (est.) qualifier can be dropped on the next amount pass. PROVENANCE NOTE: neh.gov returns HTTP 403 to automated clients including a rendering browser, so this was read through the search index rather than fetched directly — weaker than a direct read.

updates.status_evidence: Next application deadline “July 9, 2026 11:59 pm Eastern Time” for Part 1 via Grants.gov. No suspension notice.

updates.program_name: Science to Achieve Results (STAR) Research Grants
updates.status_evidence: “EPA funds extramural research through its Science to Achieve Results (STAR) program and the People, Prosperity, and the Planet (P3) Program”. No suspension or discontinuation notice.
updates.notes_append: Status verified at programme level 2026-09-17; the page names STAR as a current funding route but lists no specific open solicitation or deadline.

updates.status_evidence: NIJ describes the fellowship in the present tense as a current programme with no discontinuation notice; page publication date 1 October 2024.
updates.notes_append: Status evidence 2026-09-17 is a page last dated 2024, which is weaker than a live deadline. Re-check when NIJ posts its next solicitation.

updates.program_name: W.E.B. Du Bois Program of Research on Reducing Racial and Ethnic Disparities in the Justice System
updates.status_evidence: “The W.E.B. Du Bois Fellowship for Research on Reducing Racial and Ethnic Disparities in the Justice System supports quantitative and qualitative research”; page updated 20 December 2024 with a 2024 award listed. No suspension or renaming notice.
updates.notes_append: Status evidence 2026-09-17 is a page last dated 2024. Given the subject matter this is a row to re-check sooner than the default.

updates.status_evidence: “DOT invests in the future of transportation through its University Transportation Centers (UTC) Program, which awards and administers grants to consortia of colleges and universities”; described as “Congressionally-mandated” and in place since 1987.
updates.notes_append: Resolved 2026-09-17 with a rendering browser; transportation.gov returns HTTP 403 to a plain text fetch.

updates.program_name: National Leadership Grants (for Museums; parallel Libraries program noted)
updates.status_evidence: “The FY 2027 Notice of Funding Opportunity is now available” with “Deadline: November 13, 2026”.
updates.notes_append: IMLS carries a standing caveat that all programmes are subject to the availability of funds and IMLS discretion.

updates.program_name: DHS Science & Technology Directorate Centers of Excellence (COE)
updates.status_evidence: Nine current Centers of Excellence listed with leadership; “Each DHS Center of Excellence (COE) is led by a U.S. college or university in partnership”; page last updated 7 March 2025. Completed centres are listed separately as Emeritus, a normal lifecycle rather than a closure.
AHRQ's Notice of Funding Opportunities page is live and describes its RFA and Program Announcement routes in the present tense: “All RFAs are published in the NIH Guide for Grants and Contracts”.
updates.notes_append: Resolved 2026-09-17 with a rendering browser; ahrq.gov returns HTTP 403 to a plain text fetch. Verified at agency level: the page confirms AHRQ is issuing opportunities but does not name a specific open R01 announcement. Consider re-pointing source_url at ahrq.gov/funding/fund-opps/index.html.

updates.program_name: Sea Grant John A. Knauss Marine Policy Fellowship
updates.notes_append: UNRESOLVED 2026-09-17: seagrant.noaa.gov returned an empty body to both a text fetch (HTTP 403) and a rendering browser. Status stays unknown; needs a different NOAA Sea Grant source.
